name: csv-export
title: Make the Data app's CSV download easier to use
pitch:
The Export CSV button in the Data app gives me a file, but the first line doesn't say what each column is, so I have to guess in my spreadsheet. A big table also takes ages to download.

Please make the file start with the column names, and make an export of about 10,000 rows finish in a few seconds.

comments.author: maya-builds
comments.text: Same here. I'd also like the button to be easy to find for people who are signed in.

comments.author: sam-uplands
comments.text: Keep the columns in the order the table shows them, please.
